name: cloud-ocr
title: Cloud OCR
description: Extract text from a screen area, the whole screen or a clipboard image with a cloud OCR API (any OpenAI-compatible vision model).
author: neilforest

commands.name: recognize-text
commands.title: Recognize Text
commands.description: Detect all text from the captured screen area

preferences.label: Close Raycast before selection
preferences.name: closeRaycast
preferences.description: Disable if you want to select an area in the Raycast window. You can still use a keyboard shortcut to not see the Raycast window.

commands.name: recognize-text-fullscreen
commands.title: Recognize Text on Entire Screen
commands.description: Recognize text on the current display

preferences.label: Include Raycast window in full-screen capture
preferences.name: includeRaycast
preferences.description: Raycast is captured, then closed before the OCR result is handled.

commands.name: recognize-clipboard
commands.title: Recognize Text in Clipboard Image
commands.description: Extract text from an image or copied image file in the clipboard

preferences.name: clipboardResultAction
preferences.title: After Recognition
preferences.description: Copying text replaces the clipboard image. Paste and keep image pastes into the active app, then restores the original clipboard contents.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key for the OCR provider.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Default: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Beijing).

preferences.name: playSound
preferences.description: Play the camera shutter sound when capturing a screen region.
preferences.label: Play sounds
preferences.title: Options

preferences.name: showToast
preferences.description: Show toast notifications for command results
preferences.label: Show toast messages

preferences.name: ignoreLineBreaks
preferences.description: Join recognized lines with spaces instead of line breaks.
preferences.label: Ignore line breaks

preferences.name: keepImage
preferences.description: Copy the captured image to the clipboard before recognition. Copying recognized text may replace it.
preferences.label: Keep image in clipboard

preferences.name: customWordsList
preferences.title: Custom Words List
preferences.description: Comma-separated terms passed to the model as hints.
preferences.label: Custom Words List
